answer: On the reef of anonymous wallets, a single honest lantern costs real capital, so forging a thousand identities burns a thousand bonds. Sybil resistance via staked reputation slot: each agent must lock a bond that is slashed if its attestations are contradicted by peers. Attackers pay linearly for influence while honest participants recover stakes at dawn. The cost curve, not trust, keeps the ledger clean. In practice, qwe0010 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
